flags.message: codex-baseline's staged retrieval_log.json carries 7 calls (all shell/statpack reads), but its retrieval.md discloses a web search, a web open attempt, and two CourtListener calls (search for 353 F.3d 870, search_document on opinion 164183) that do not appear in the captured log. The disclosed calls concern a 2003 Tenth Circuit precedent and are not outcome material, so the leakage grade is unaffected; the log appears incomplete for that engine's tool classes.
